import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for secure web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML‑formatted string ready for presentation. Raises ------ ValueError If the headline is empty or contains only whitespace. """ if not headline or headline.strip() == "": raise ValueError("Headline cannot be empty") # Escape user-supplied text to prevent XSS and other injection attacks. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Render the final HTML using the predefined format. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
